Notes.Text:
This update for java-25-openjdk fixes the following issues:

Security issues fixed:

- CVE-2026-83374: improper PKCS5 padding handling  can lead to unauthorized data modification (bsc#1286472).
- CVE-2026-83376: improper TLS certificate handling and authorization in JSSE component can lead to unauthorized data
  modification (bsc#1286474).
- CVE-2026-83378: improper JIT optimization and bounds validation in Compiler component can lead to partial
  unauthorized data modification (bsc#1286475).
- CVE-2026-83380: improper authorization during LDAP logins in JAAS component can lead to sensitive data disclosure
  (bsc#1286476).
- CVE-2026-83381: improper authorization in SASL authentication can lead to unauthorized reading or modification of
  sensitive data (bsc#1286477).
- CVE-2026-83387: improper authentication in WebRowSets handling within JDBC component can lead to sensitive data
  exposure (bsc#1286478).
- CVE-2026-83395: improper authorization in HTTP Client response handling within Networking component can lead to
  denial of service or data modification (bsc#1286479).
- CVE-2026-83400: improper restriction of recursive XML entity expansion in JAXP component can lead to partial denial
  of service (bsc#1286480).
- CVE-2026-87255: improper type and bounds validation during JIT compilation in Compiler component can lead to denial
  of service and partial unauthorized data modification (bsc#1286483).
- CVE-2026-87290: improper restriction of XPath expression evaluation in JAXP component can lead to unauthorized
  sensitive data disclosure (bsc#1286484).
- CVE-2026-87291: improper URL parsing and authorization in Networking component can lead to unauthorized data
  modification (bsc#1286485).
- CVE-2026-87292: improper authorization in Network Clients within Networking component can lead to unauthorized
  modification of sensitive data (bsc#1286486).
- CVE-2026-87294: improper certificate name verification can lead to unauthorized reading or modification of sensitive
  data (bsc#1286490).
- CVE-2026-87367: improper authorization in XML template handling within JAXP component can lead to unauthorized data
  modification (bsc#1286943).
- CVE-2026-91332: improper authorization in HTTP connection handling within Networking component can lead to
  unauthorized data modification (bsc#1286491).
- CVE-2026-91333: improper cryptographic signature verification in Security component can lead to unauthorized data
  modification (bsc#1286492).
- CVE-2026-91334: improper authorization during JPEG loading in ImageIO component can lead to sensitive data disclosure
  (bsc#1286493).
- CVE-2026-91335: improper authorization in image handling within AWT component can lead to sensitive data disclosure
  (bsc#1286494).
- CVE-2026-91373: improper authorization during TLS handshakes in JSSE component can lead to denial of service
  (bsc#1286495).
- CVE-2026-91374: improper authorization in `jstatd` within Serviceability component can lead to unauthorized reading
  or modification of sensitive data (bsc#1286496).
- CVE-2026-91375: improper input validation in core APIs within Libraries component can lead to denial of service and
  partial unauthorized data modification (bsc#1286497).
- CVE-2026-91379: improper command-line argument and path handling in JDK tools can lead to unauthorized local file
  modification (bsc#1286498).
- CVE-2026-91380: improper authorization in Preferences handling within Utility component can lead to local sensitive
  data disclosure or modification (bsc#1286500).
- CVE-2026-91394: improper header validation in HTTP Client within Networking component can lead to unauthorized data
  modification (bsc#1286507).  
- CVE-2026-91397: improper authorization in diagnostic sessions within Serviceability component can lead to local
  sensitive data disclosure (bsc#1286513).
- CVE-2026-91398: improper authorization in SOCKS5 proxy support within Networking component can lead to unauthorized
  data modification (bsc#1286515).
- CVE-2026-91400: improper validation during MIDI file handling in Sound component can lead to denial of service
  (bsc#1286517).
- CVE-2026-91403: incomplete blocklist mitigation for weak eMudhra intermediate CA certificates can lead to TLS
  spoofing and man-in-the-middle attacks (bsc#1287264).
- CVE-2026-91415: improper authentication in font rendering within 2D component can lead to denial of service or
  unauthorized data reading and modification (bsc#1286537).  
- CVE-2026-91418: improper authorization during GIF image loading in ImageIO component can lead to denial of service
  (bsc#1286539).
- CVE-2026-91451: inconsistent HTTP request parsing in Networking component can lead to unauthorized data modification
  (bsc#1286542).
- CVE-2026-91452: improper authorization in HTTP server request handling can lead to unauthorized data modification
  (bsc#1286544).
- CVE-2026-91453: inconsistent HTTP header interpretation in Lightweight HTTP Server component can lead to unauthorized
  data modification (bsc#1286545).
- CVE-2026-91461: improper authorization in TLS Extensions handling within JSSE component can lead to unauthorized
  modification of sensitive data (bsc#1286546).
- CVE-2026-91462: improper authentication in Kerberos token handling within JGSS component can lead to unauthorized
  modification of sensitive data (bsc#1286547).
- CVE-2026-91463: improper authentication in Kerberos client handling within JGSS component can lead to sensitive
  data disclosure (bsc#1286549).
- CVE-2026-91464: improper Kerberos ticket/credential validation within JGSS component can lead to sensitive data
  disclosure (bsc#1286550).
- CVE-2026-91487: improper optimization assumptions in JIT Compiler component can lead to partial unauthorized data
  reading and modification (bsc#1286551).  
- CVE-2026-101516: improper certificate constraint checking in Libraries component can lead to unauthorized reading
  and modification of sensitive data (bsc#1286395).
- CVE-2026-114820: trust of root CA certificates that signed weak eMudhra intermediate CA certificates in JSSE
  component can lead to TLS spoofing and man-in-the-middle attacks (bsc#1287962).
- CVE-2026-114938: OpenJDK base64 decoder heap corruption with AVX-512 enabled (bsc#1290745).
- CVE-2026-114939: security flaw in the JGSS component can lead to unauthorized access and complete modification of
  Java-accessible data in sandboxed client deployments (bsc#1290781).
- CVE-2026-114940: flaw in the JSSE component over TLS can lead to unauthorized access and complete modification of
  Java-accessible data (bsc#1290782).
- CVE-2026-114941: flaw in the Compiler component can lead to complete denial of service and partial unauthorized
  read/write access (bsc#1290783).
- CVE-2026-114942: flaw in the Libraries component can lead to complete denial of service and partial unauthorized
  read/write access (bsc#1290785).
- CVE-2026-114943: flaw in the Hotspot component can lead to complete denial of service and partial unauthorized
  modification (bsc#1290784).
- CVE-2026-114944: flaw in the Core Java Libraries component can lead to complete unauthorized creation, deletion, or
  modification of Java-accessible data (bsc#1290786).
- CVE-2026-114945: flaw in the Libraries component can lead to partial unauthorized modification, insertion, or deletion
  of Java-accessible data (bsc#1290787).
- CVE-2026-114946: flaw in the Compiler component can lead to partial unauthorized read, update, insertion, or deletion
  of Java-accessible data (bsc#1290788).
- CVE-2026-114947: flaw in the JSSE component over TLS can lead to partial unauthorized modification of Java-accessible
  data in sandboxed client deployments (bsc#1290789).

Non security issue fixed:

- java-{25,26}-openjdk-jmods packages contain huge unstripped jmods with debug info + unstripped binaries in
  java-25-openj9 (bsc#1282358).

Changes for java-25-openjdk:

Update to upstream tag jdk-25.0.5.1+2 (November 2026 CSPU)

 with high CPU core number and running with high concurrency

 libj2pkcs11 and adjust malloc rv handling

 with -parameters

 result
 + JDK-8382608: Shenandoah: STS yield deadlocks in OOM-evac scope

 compact object headers

 with a generic type parameter shadowing a record class

 + JDK-8380896: Reduce runtime for MonitorVmStartTerminate.java

 some providers

 on cgroup v1

 'timestamp has changed'
